name: Shopify
description: Search a store's products and policies, and manage shopping carts.

methods.whenToUse: Use a store's public myshopify.com domain. No Shopify app or OAuth registration is required.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Shopify's official Storefront MCP server for shopper-facing catalog, policy, and cart tools.
methods.label: Connect a Shopify storefront

tenantFields.label: Store domain
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the full myshopify.com domain without https://.

warnings: This is Shopify's Storefront MCP, not Admin API access. It does not manage merchant products, orders, or customers.
The storefront must be publicly reachable. Password-protected or restricted trial stores can return HTTP 401.
